opportunities.title: Funding for ecologists in the Global South

next_open_date.raw: Ecologists in Global South countries can apply for funding through any grant scheme offered by the BES, whichever suits them and their projects best.

amount.raw: We have set a target that at least 51% of our available funding will support Global South ecologists.

opportunities.summary: Supports projects where there is a clear ecological science focus to the work; any other aspects, i.e. sociology, economics, etc., must be clearly integrated into the ecology and scientific goals of the project.

opportunities.title: Small research grants

amount.raw: Small Research Grants, up to £5,000: Further eligibility criteria for PhD students

opportunities.summary: Supports projects where there is a clear ecological science focus to the work; any other aspects, i.e. sociology, economics, etc., must be clearly integrated into the ecology and scientific goals of the project.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

amount.raw: A maximum of £250 is available to cover the registration fees for virtual conferences/courses. A maximum of £500 is available for events in person

opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers to meet the costs of specialist field training courses and to network and publicise their research by presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000.

opportunities.summary: Facilitates research informing teaching and learning practices which improve learners’ experience while promoting excellence in teaching.

opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.summary: Brings together diverse interdisciplinary groups of 8-15 individuals to focus on data analysis and synthesis while fostering collaboration and mentoring opportunities.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

amount.raw: You will be able to claim the first five years’ worth of funding in year 1, which is £3,500.

opportunities.summary: Provides funding for projects such as ecological restoration, habitat creation, control of alien species and climate change anywhere in the world.
